ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases, including the Trump administration's crackdown on fraud in multiple states.
ideas.angle: Investigative analysis of Medicaid fraud cases
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How effective has the Trump administration's crackdown been?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight in the Medicaid program. By analyzing recent cases and trends, we can identify patterns and connections that may lead to further investigation and accountability.
